The Jungle Book

On a warm evening in the Seeonee hills, a family of wolves finds someone at the threshold of their cave—a human child, who grows up among animals and learns the laws of the jungle.

Story by Rudyard Kipling

The Wolf Wilder

“Fairy tale and history merge seamlessly” in this enchanting and lyrical novel about love, survival, and the wild spirit that cannot be tamed.

Novel by K. Rundell

The Girl of Ink & Stars

Forbidden to leave her island, Isabella dreams of the faraway lands her cartographer father once mapped. When her friend disappears, she begins a dangerous journey.

Book by Kiran M. Hargrave

Cogheart

When 13-year-old Lily’s inventor father vanishes after a Zeppelin crash, Lily’s determined to hunt down the truth behind his disappearance before it is too late.

Novel by Peter Bunzl

Macbeth

“Fairy tale and history merge seamlessly” in this intense tragedy of ambition, prophecy, guilt, and power, one of Shakespeare’s darkest and most memorable plays.

Play by William Shakespeare
